system.biography:
A titan is about 25 feet tall and weighs about 14,000 pounds.

Titans speak Abyssal, Common, Celestial, Draconic, and Giant.

Combat

A titan’s natural weapons, as well as any weapons it wields, are treated as chaotic-aligned for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.

Oversized Weapon (Ex)

A titan wields a great, two-handed warhammer (big enough for Gargantuan creatures) without penalty.

Spell-Like Abilities

At will—chain lightning (DC 23), charm monster (DC 21), cure critical wounds (DC 21), fire storm (DC 24), greater dispel magic, hold monster (DC 22), invisibility, invisibility purge, levitate, persistent image (DC 22); 3/day—etherealness, word of chaos (DC 22), summon nature’s ally IX; 1/day—gate, maze, meteor swarm (DC 26). Caster level 20th. The save DCs are Charisma-based.

In addition, titans of good or neutral alignment can use the following additional spell-like abilities

At will—daylight, holy smite (DC 21), remove curse (DC 21); 1/day—greater restoration. Caster level 20th. The save DCs are Charisma-based.

Titans of evil alignment can use the following additional spell-like abilities

At will—bestow curse (DC 21), deeper darkness, unholy blight (DC 21); 1/day—crushing hand (DC 26). Caster level 20th. The save DCs are Charisma-based.

Change Shape (Su)

A titan can assume the form of any Small or Medium humanoid. The titan retains its oversized weapon special attack regardless of form.

Tactics Round-By-Round

Titans enjoy combat and usually close with their foes. If that proves ineffective, they swiftly back off and pelt the foe with spell-like abilities and magical effects. Because of a titan’s Quicken Spell-Like Ability feat, it can use chain lightning as a free action, and frequently attacks in melee while lashing out with this ability at the same time.

  • Prior to combat: Invisibility purge or invisibility.
  • Round 1: Charge and attempt to sunder the weapon of the most dangerous foe. Hurl chain lightning at opponents standing away from the fight.
  • Round 2: Full attack against the disarmed opponent, and hurl chain lightning at other opponents.
  • Round 3: Back away from first opponent and use maze or meteor swarm on any spellcaster causing trouble.
  • Round 4: Sunder the weapon of the next most effective combatant, or use greater dispel magic on all nearby opponents.
  • Round 5: Full attack against any nearby opponent, or use fire storm.

Use another quickened chain lightning if foes seem really dangerous.

A titan usually reserves its gate and etherealness abilities to escape a fight that is not going well.

system.description: As a standard action, the creature may choose to subtract 4 from its melee attack roll and deliver an awesome blow.
system.prerequisites: Str 25, Power Attack, Improved Bull Rush, size Large or larger
system.benefit: If the creature hits a Huge or smaller opponent with an awesome blow, the opponent must succeed on a Fortitude save (DC = damage dealt) or be knocked flying 10 feet in a direction of the attacker’s choice and fall prone.

system.description: You are skilled at fighting opponents you cannot clearly see.
system.benefit:
In melee, every time you miss because of concealment, you can reroll your miss chance percentile roll one time to see if you actually hit.

An invisible attacker gets no advantages related to hitting you in melee. That is, you don't lose your Dexterity bonus to Armor Class, and the attacker doesn't get the usual +2 bonus to hit you. The invisible attacker's bonuses do still apply for ranged attacks, however.

You take only half the usual penalty to speed for being unable to see. Darkness and poor visibility in general reduces your speed to three-quarters normal, instead of one-half.
system.special: A fighter may select Blind-Fight as one of his fighter bonus feats.

system.description: You can strike two adjacent foes with a single swing.
system.benefit: As a standard action, you can make a single attack at your full base attack bonus against a foe within reach. If you hit, you deal damage normally and can make an additional attack (using your full base attack bonus) against a foe that is adjacent to the first and also within reach. You can only make one additional attack per round with this feat. You cannot use this feat if you are wearing heavy armor.
system.special: A fighter may select Cleave as one of his fighter bonus feats.

system.description: You are skilled at pushing your opponents around.
system.benefit: When you perform a bull rush, you do not provoke an attack of opportunity from the defender. You also gain a +4 bonus on the opposed Strength check you make to push back the defender.
system.special: A fighter may select Improved Bull Rush as one of his fighter bonus feats.

system.description: You are skilled at damaging your opponents' weapons and armor.
system.benefit: When you strike at an opponent's weapon or shield, you do not provoke an attack of opportunity. You also gain a +4 bonus on any attack roll made to attack an object held or carried by another character.
system.special: A fighter may select Improved Sunder as one of his fighter bonus feats.

system.description: You can make exceptionally powerful melee attacks.
system.benefit: On your action, before making attack rolls for a round, you may choose to subtract a number from all melee attack rolls and add the same number to all melee damage rolls. This number may not exceed your base attack bonus. The penalty on attacks and bonus on damage apply until your next turn.

system.description: Check: You can walk on a precarious surface. A successful check lets you move at half your speed along the surface for 1 round. A failure by 4 or less means you can't move for 1 round. A failure by 5 or more means you fall.
You know how to tell a lie.
Check: With each successful Climb check, you can advance up, down, or across a slope, wall, or other steep incline (or even a ceiling with handholds) at one-quarter your normal speed.
Make a Concentration check whenever you might be distracted (by taking damage, by harsh weather, and so on) while engaged in some action that requires your full attention.
You can use this skill to persuade others to agree with your arguments, to resolve differences, and to gather valuable information or rumors from people.
You are skilled at changing your appearance.
You are skilled at tending to wounds and ailments.
You can use this skill to frighten opponents or to get them to act in a way that benefits you.
You can make running or standing jumps.
Ancient mysteries, magic traditions, arcane symbols, cryptic phrases, constructs, dragons, magical beasts. Like other Knowledge skills, each Knowledge field is a separate skill with its own ranks.
Your Listen check is either made against a DC that reflects how quiet the noise is that you might hear, or it is opposed by the target's Move Silently check.
You can find secret doors, traps, and hidden objects.
You can get a hunch about a social situation or read a person.
You are skilled at working with magic and can identify spells as they are cast or spells already in place.
Your Spot check is either made against a DC that reflects how obvious the object is, or it is opposed by the target's Hide check.
You are skilled at surviving in the wild and at following tracks.
Make a Swim check once per round while you are in the water. Success means you may swim at up to one-half your speed (as a full-round action) or at one-quarter your speed (as a move action).

Titan spell-like abilities (SRD): chain lightning, clairaudience/clairvoyance, daylight, death ward, dispel magic, etherealness, fire storm, hold monster, invisibility, levitate, persistent image, polymorph, protection from energy, see invisibility, summon nature's ally IX, summon monster IX, and telekinesis at will; gate and maze 3/day.
